latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Video Editor Remastered.

- Instantly remaster and export HD videos using AI—no manual editing required.
- Supports MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM uploads up to 500MB; outputs 1080p MP4 in 1–2 minutes.
- Automatic session and token setup for free access (100 credits, 7-day token).
- Cloud-based processing—no local installation needed.
- Simple commands for upload, export, credits, and session management.
- Clear error handling and export attribution headers built in.
